d:
Salim Khan, is an Indian film actor, producer, and screenwriter. He Wrote many screenplays together with Javed Akhtar as team Salim-Javed. As a writer, he is known for Sholay (1975), Deewaar (1975), and Zanjeer (1973).
He is the father of three Bollywood actors, Salman Khan, Sohail Khan, and Arbaaz Khan, and film producer Alvira Khan Agnihotri. He is married to Sushila Charak also known as Salma Khan and to actress Helen Richardson Khan.
